english.note: Use this everyday pattern when you want to link an explicit although-clause to its contrasting main clause.
Use this common spoken pattern when you want to link both the concessive clause and the contrasting main clause explicitly.

examples.english: Though the road is far, we'll get there after walking for a while.
examples.traditional: 雖然條路好遠，但係我哋行下行下就到喇。
